name: HeyClicky
long_description: HeyClicky sits right next to your cursor and sees everything you see. ask a question out loud and it walks you through whatever you're working on. Or say “HeyClicky Agent” and it'll spin up an agent to build, research, or do whatever for you in the background.
one_liner: The simplest interface in the world to talk AI models + spawn agents

launches.title: This is HeyClicky. An AI buddy that lives next to your computer cursor.
launches.body:
This is HeyClicky!

He’s a lil buddy that lives next to your cursor.

It’s the simplest interface in the world to interact with the models and spawn agents.

Built for consumers, zero setup.

It does research to help you find IG micro-influencers for your startup. It connects to your Notion, G-Mail, and Calendar. It can even build Mac apps locally.

**Just use your voice.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101393&key=user_uploads/250660/731b1eab-0010-4762-adb0-70c810f54144)

It’s 4-weeks old.

We’ve gone [super viral on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DXk3VriDylM/) and are getting insane pull.

We’re seeing kids use it make games, founders use it to research their competitors, doctors using it keep track of their busy schedule, and content creators using it to learn complex programs After Effects and DaVinci Resolve.

[Give it a try free here](https://www.heyclicky.com/), and let us know what you think.

Enjoy <3

<https://youtu.be/ER8TCqFjaYI>
